description: Look up FDA drug labeling (package inserts / SPL documents). Check indications, warnings, dosage, contraindications, active ingredients, or any structured label section. A label runs to tens of thousands of tokens, so a page that exceeds the inline budget returns the list of available sections instead; re-call with sections to pull the ones you need.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Default 5. Labels are large, and the cost of a sections selection is the section summed across every record on the page — so it scales with this limit. Lower it before widening a selection.

search.description: Query targeting label fields. Examples: openfda.brand_name:"aspirin", openfda.generic_name:"metformin", openfda.manufacturer_name:"pfizer". To fetch one product's label, pass set_id with the SPL UUID returned in earlier results; it returns the label's current revision only, since openFDA does not serve earlier ones. Separate clauses with spaces. A "+" written in the URL style of openFDA's examples also reads as a space where it separates: beside AND, OR, NOT, or TO, after a closing quote, paren, or bracket, or between a term and the next "field:" prefix (a:"x"+AND+b:"y", [20200101+TO+20201231], c:x+d:y). In a query that marks a clause required with a leading +field:, only the AND/OR/NOT/TO positions read that way. Any other "+" is sent as written, and inside a quoted phrase "+" is a literal plus sign. Double quotes, parentheses, and range brackets must balance, and the query must not end on a backslash — each is rejected before the request.

sections.description: Label sections to return, e.g. ["boxed_warning","indications_and_usage"]. Names come from the outline an oversized page returns, or from openfda_describe_fields. Omit for the whole label — which returns the section outline instead when the page exceeds the inline size budget; an empty list is treated as omitted. A selection is returned whole even when it exceeds that budget, with its serialized size reported on the notice; the outline names a section measured to fit at the requested limit. Sections ending in _table hold SPL table markup: raw in structured results, rendered as Markdown tables in the text output. Metadata (openfda, set_id, id, effective_time, version) is returned either way and counts toward the size.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0). openFDA caps pagination at 25000 records; a higher value returns a pagination_limit_reached error.

sort.description: Sort expression — a field path optionally suffixed with :asc or :desc (any letter case; :ascending and :descending are also accepted, and every direction is sent as asc or desc); comma-separate for multi-field sort. Example: effective_time:desc. Field paths take only letters, digits, underscores, and dots; any other character or direction is rejected before the request. A well-formed but non-sortable field still causes a query error — use a documented field name.

name: openfda_get_drug_label

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

effectiveQuery.description: Search filter applied to the drug label query, as submitted to openFDA

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: The openFDA daily or per-minute request limit is exceeded. `upstream_error`: The openFDA API returned a 5xx server error. `malformed_search`: The search query leaves a double quote, parenthesis, or range bracket unclosed, or ends on a backslash. `query_error`: The search query was rejected by openFDA (malformed field name, invalid syntax). `pagination_limit_reached`: skip exceeds the 25000 record pagination ceiling. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

kind.description: Whether this response carries label records ("full") or only the section outline of a page too large to inline ("outline").

lastUpdated.description: Date the dataset was last updated.

total.description: Total matching results in the dataset.

totalUnverified.description: Present (true) only on an empty page at skip > 0 whose total could not be confirmed: openFDA answers a page past the end and a search that matched nothing alike, and the follow-up request for the total failed. total then reads 0 without ruling out records at a lower skip — re-call with skip=0 to tell.

notice.description: Guidance for this page: how to broaden filters or correct field names when results are empty or paging overshot, the sized re-call example when a page overflowed to its section outline, section names no record carried, and the serialized size when a sections selection exceeds the inline budget. Absent when nothing needs saying.

outline.description: Section names available across the matched page and their serialized size, largest first. Present when kind is "outline" — pass names back in sections to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable label section and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

results.description: Drug label records, present when kind is "full". Each carries an openfda block (brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_name, route) plus optional SPL sections like indications_and_usage, warnings, dosage_and_administration, contraindications, adverse_reactions; section presence varies per label. Sections ending in _table carry raw SPL table markup (tags and character entities) exactly as openFDA returns it. Narrowed to the requested sections plus metadata when sections was supplied.

shown.description: Number of labels returned in this response.

totalResults.description: Total matching label records in the dataset

truncated.description: True when more labels matched than this page returned — page with skip for the rest.
